spoken_summary: The audio features a heated exchange during a congressional hearing between Pam Bondi and another member, likely Jerry Nadler. He accuses her of attempting to "filibuster" and says it won't be allowed on their time. Bondi retorts, "You don't tell me anything," to which he replies, "Oh, I did tell you, because we saw what you did in the Senate." Bondi then calls him a "loser lawyer," and he retorts, "not even a lawyer."

central_claim: Pam Bondi had a contentious and unprofessional exchange during a House hearing, where she was accused of filibustering and resorted to insults.
intended_effect: To portray Pam Bondi as combative and foolish, thereby undermining her credibility.
